checks.title: Lockfile present
checks.why: Without a lockfile, reinstalling resolves whatever the registry serves today instead of the versions that were tested.

checks.title: Dependencies installed
checks.why: A declared dependency that is not on disk cannot be resolved by the loader, so plugins fail to load without naming the cause.

checks.title: Lockfile matches package.json
checks.why: A dependency added to package.json but never locked installs on one machine and fails on a frozen-lockfile install.

checks.title: One version per dependency
checks.why: Two resolved copies of one package give the harness two module instances, so plugins compare unequal across copies.

checks.title: Unique plugin ids
checks.why: Two packages declaring one plugin id means the loader keeps one and silently discards the other, which is how a UI control disappears.

checks.title: Plugin supports this harness
checks.why: A plugin whose engines.dsh range excludes the installed harness may still load and then behave against interfaces that moved.

checks.title: Client bundle newer than its sources
checks.why: A client bundle older than its package manifest or sources renders the previous UI while the server runs the new code.

checks.title: Plugin entry file exists
checks.why: A plugin whose manifest points at an absent entry file fails at load time with a module-resolution error instead of a manifest error.

checks.title: Settings file parses
checks.why: An unparsable settings file is dropped as a whole, so every setting silently reverts to its default.

checks.title: Settings keys are known
checks.why: An unknown key is accepted and ignored, so a setting the operator believes is active never takes effect.

checks.title: Settings paths resolve
checks.why: An absolute path that no longer exists makes the owning feature fail on first use rather than at startup.

checks.title: No orphaned locks
checks.why: A lock left by a crashed run blocks the next run from claiming the same resource and reads as a hang, not an error.

checks.title: Session store is bounded
checks.why: An unbounded session store slows session listing and makes pruning a surprise later instead of a scheduled task now.

checks.title: Harness state is ignored
checks.why: Committed .dsh state carries session logs and lock files between machines and produces conflicts on every checkout.

checks.title: No oversized workspace files
checks.why: A large file at the workspace root is read by workspace scans and slows every session that walks the tree.
